Yassa cakkhāyatanaṁ nirujjhati tassa sotāyatanaṁ nirujjhatīti?
yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti:
(Ka) yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti?
yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati tassa sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhatīti:
Sacakkhukānaṁ asotakānaṁ cavantānaṁ tesaṁ cakkhāyatanaṁ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṁ sotāyatanaṁ nirujjhati. Sacakkhukānaṁ sasotakānaṁ cavantānaṁ tesaṁ cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhati sotāyatanañca nirujjhati.

sacakkhukānaṃ asotakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ sotāyatanaṃ nirujjhati. sacakkhukānaṃ sasotakānaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhāyatanañca nirujjhati, sotāyatanañca nirujjhati.

3.2.3.1.4. Paccanīkapuggala
(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo (Ka)
Yassa cakkhāyatanaṁ nuppajjati tassa sotāyatanaṁ na nirujjhatīti?
yassa cakkhāyatanaṃ nūppajjati tassa sotāyatanaṃ na nirujjhatīti:
